title: Review formal V2 authority documents
goal: Independently verify registered normative V2 documents against accepted proposal fingerprints and the BL-003 development gate
acceptance_criteria: Review checks every TASK-029 change, document registration, metadata, and canonical-body equivalence to accepted subjects
Review rejects any semantic design change, missing requirement trace, or premature development authorization before active BL-003
Release evidence records exact change manifest, normative/proposal fingerprints, findings, and two consecutive full passes

release_controls.target_environment: local dev branch normative V2 review workspace
release_controls.execution_window: current V2 authority independent review stage
release_controls.rollback_plan: remove unrecorded review evidence and return TASK-029 for correction
release_controls.observation_metrics: canonical equivalence, registry consistency, traceability coverage, exact changes, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: fingerprint mismatch, scope drift, missing registration, or incomplete evidence
